issue.title: Serialize the capture_pomodoros BOB_DAY_FILE test mutation
issue.description:
`capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes` reads the process-global `BOB_DAY_FILE` while `tests::with_env` in the same module sets and clears that variable with no lock.

`capture_complete::tests` already documents the race and holds `DAY_FILE_LOCK` around every day-file override (`src/native/capture_complete.rs`, the static just above `day_file_guard`). That mutex is private to the module, so `capture_pomodoros` cannot take it. Lib tests share one process, so a `capture_complete` test can set `BOB_DAY_FILE` while the pomodoros missing-note test expects the default day file to be absent (or the reverse).

bob-cli-2c.1 proposed quarantining or serializing these env-mutating tests. The helper and the test predate this epic: both are from `cc4c9a38` (2026-08-28), "feat(capture): list pomodoro ledger entries". This landing did not catch a fresh fail-then-pass run; the defect is the unlocked mutation, which is visible in the two `with_env` implementations.

Share one process-wide lock (the private `DAY_FILE_LOCK` does not serialize across modules) or stop the pomodoros test from mutating the environment. Do not treat this as part of epic bob-cli-2c.

task_type_fields.impact: Parallel `cargo test --lib` can fail a warning-success assertion that has been in tree since 2026-08-28, or can hide a real missing-note failure by pointing the test at another test's day file. The start epic's own suite is unaffected when tests run serially.
task_type_fields.repro: Read `src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs` `tests::with_env` (sets `BOB_DAY_FILE` via `std::env::set_var` with no mutex) and `missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes`, which calls `list_capture_pomodoros` once with the ambient env and once inside `with_env`. Then read `src/native/capture_complete.rs` `tests::DAY_FILE_LOCK`: the comment says parallel tests must never set and read `BOB_DAY_FILE` at the same time, and `day_file_guard` is module-private. `rg BOB_DAY_FILE src/native/capture_complete.rs` shows many tests take that lock; the pomodoros test does not. A parallel `cargo test --lib` can therefore observe another test's day file during the missing-note assertion. This landing did not re-run that suite to time a failure.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-2c.1 proposed serializing the capture_pomodoros BOB_DAY_FILE test mutation. The unlocked process-global write predates that epic and is not caused by the Pomodoro start work, so it is a separate bug.

evidence.note: bob-cli-2z.1 and bob-cli-2z.2 independently reported the same parallel-only missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failure on a clean base; source audit confirms capture_pomodoros::tests::with_env mutates process-global BOB_DAY_FILE without the shared DAY_FILE_LOCK used by capture_complete tests. It passes serially; the race predates bob-cli-2z and is unrelated to typed close logs.

bob-cli-34.5 (priority roll decay docs phase, epic bob-cli-34) independently hit missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failing once in a full just test run on 2026-10-01, then passing on rerun and in isolation; its change only added a config-parse test in src/native/config/mod.rs, so the failure is the same parallel BOB_DAY_FILE race, unrelated to that epic.

Landing bob-cli-3b: proposals from bob-cli-3b.1 note #1 (capture_complete missing-day flake), bob-cli-3b.2 note #1, and bob-cli-3b.3 note #1 (capture_pomodoros missing-note flakes) share this existing BOB_DAY_FILE race. Independent source audit on e77bbe3 confirms capture_pomodoros.rs:1189 first reads ambient process env and :1277 with_env sets/removes BOB_DAY_FILE without a mutex; capture_complete.rs:2119 uses a module-private DAY_FILE_LOCK inaccessible to pomodoros tests. Phase .2/.3 report failure on clean base and success alone; no fresh failure run claimed by this lander. One shared process-wide environment guard/removal fixes both sides, so no duplicate task filed.

Independent repro from the bob-cli-3f landing (proposed by bob-cli-3f.5 as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP): on master 447e97d plus the land diff, full 'cargo test --lib' failed this test 5 of 5 runs (assert_eq!(missing.count, 0) at capture_pomodoros.rs:1196, left 1 right 0: the ambient-env first call saw another test's BOB_DAY_FILE). It passes in isolation. At the pre-epic commit 5d24c98 it failed 1 of 3 full lib runs, so the race predates bob-cli-3f. Impact: 'just all' / 'cargo test' now fails nearly every run on athena, and the failing lib binary stops cargo before the CLI integration tests run unless --no-fail-fast is used. capture_pomodoros tests::with_env still sets BOB_DAY_FILE with no lock while capture_complete holds its module-private DAY_FILE_LOCK.

Proposed by bob-cli-3i.1 note #1: phase reports parallel capture_pomodoros/capture_complete failure reproduced on clean base, with 1487/1487 lib tests green single-threaded. Land audit on 74f47d4 independently confirms capture_pomodoros.rs:1189 reads ambient BOB_DAY_FILE and :1277 with_env sets/removes it without a lock, while capture_complete.rs:2118 has only a module-private DAY_FILE_LOCK. This is the existing pre-epic race; no fresh fail-then-pass execution claimed by this lander and no duplicate task created.

Landing bob-cli-3n: phase bob-cli-3n.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) independently reported capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failing ~1/3 of default-parallel lib runs on the clean base tree during the Depends-On reconcile work (2026-10-02), and saw the same env-var race once in note_ready::scan_excludes_r3_and_r7_paths. Root cause it named matches this bead: with_env helpers mutate process-global env with no shared lock. The lander's own 'just all' on f21e856 passed (1556/1556 lib) this time, so no fresh failure is claimed here; note the second test (note_ready) when fixing so one process-wide env guard covers both.

Re-observed twice during epic bob-cli-3n.12 (2026-10-03): phase bob-cli-3n.12.5 saw missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes fail once under parallel 'just all' at bob-cli ~79e39af and pass in isolation; phase bob-cli-3n.12.7 saw the same parallel cargo test failure at ~3b04a06, passing in isolation. Impact: every bob-cli epic phase still has to rerun it by hand before trusting a red suite.

Landing bob-cli-3n.12.9 (proposed by bob-cli-3n.12.9.1 note #1): note_ready::tests::scan_excludes_r3_and_r7_paths failed once under parallel cargo test (count 2 vs 1), passing alone and on rerun. Source audit on master 72964be: the test computes tomorrow via crate::native::env::current_datetime() (reads process-global BOB_NOW, src/native/env.rs:92) and the scan reads it again, while capture_complete.rs:2959 tests run with_env("BOB_NOW", "2026-09-30 09:02:00") — if BOB_NOW flips between the two reads, the 'Future [scheduled::]' task is not future and counts, giving 2. Same root cause class as this bead (lib tests mutating process env without one shared lock); the lander's own just all on 72964be also failed missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes once (1560/1561), passing in isolation and on a --no-fail-fast rerun. One process-wide env guard should cover BOB_DAY_FILE and BOB_NOW readers.

bob-cli-3n.12.9.6.3 (DP30 chips phase) reported missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failing on its first just all run, then passing alone and on rerun. The bob-cli-3n.12.9.6 land agent reproduced it on master 50350db on 2026-10-03: cargo test --lib gave 1560 pass, 1 fail (panic at src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs:1196, left 1 right 0), and the test passed when run alone. That epic changed only reconcile.rs, the task_dependencies tests and docs, so the race predates it and is unrelated.

Epic bob-cli-3s (split five largest Rust files) phases bob-cli-3s.2, .3, and .5 each independently hit missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes failing under default-parallel full cargo test / just all on 2026-10-03 (3s.2: reproduced 2 of 3 runs on a clean base tree; 3s.3: 2 of 4 runs, passes isolated and with --test-threads=4; 3s.5: assertion left==1 right==0 at capture_pomodoros.rs:1196). src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs was untouched by the epic. Location update for the fix: the epic moved capture_complete's private DAY_FILE_LOCK and day_file_guard from src/native/capture_complete.rs into src/native/capture_complete/tests/mod.rs (static at line 23); it is still module-private, so the cross-module race is unchanged. The bob-cli-3s land run's own just all passed (1561 lib tests).

Independent repro on 2026-10-04 during freshness-decay-without-trial-date landing (bob-cli_13). Two consecutive default-parallel just all runs failed native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes at src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs:1196 (assert_eq missing.count 0): first run left=1, second run left=2. Isolated cargo test --lib --exact passed. Unrelated to freshness/NO_COLOR work; corroborates the unlocked BOB_DAY_FILE race vs capture_complete DAY_FILE_LOCK.

Independent reproduction on 2026-10-04 during bob-cli-46.2 just test && just install-smoke (monitor dze2gbcn5xyh): native::capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes panicked at src/native/capture_pomodoros.rs:1196 assert_eq!(missing.count, 0) left=1 right=0. Isolated cargo test --lib --exact passed. capture_pomodoros.rs is unmodified vs HEAD 660c171; this phase only nested task/pomodoro groups. Same unlocked BOB_DAY_FILE race vs capture_complete DAY_FILE_LOCK tracked here and as flake bob-cli-40.

Proposed by bob-cli-46.2 note #3: its parallel just test failed missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes with count 1 vs 0, then passed unchanged in isolation. Independent bob-cli-46 land source audit on 192e8b5 confirms capture_pomodoros tests still mutate process-global BOB_DAY_FILE without the capture_complete module-private DAY_FILE_LOCK; epic commits did not modify that test. Same root cause, also described by bob-cli-40; no new task or fresh failure execution claimed by the lander.

bob-cli-4w.land on master e3e69df: full parallel just all lib run failed capture_pomodoros::tests::missing_note_and_missing_section_are_warning_successes; isolated --exact rerun passed. Phase bob-cli-4w.6 note #2 also saw note_ready::tests::scan_excludes_r3_and_r7_paths fail in a parallel run on clean base 3642b4a and pass isolated.

payload.entry: done: shared thread-local test-env isolation (src/native/env.rs TestEnvGuard) replaces the module-private with_env; production reads go through bob_env::var/var_os; no test touches process env (rg env::set_var/remove_var clean except the one-time TZ pin). Victim missing_note test green in 20/20 subset runs and every full lib run; full cargo test --lib 1874/1874 on athena, tree master 6244ddd plus uncommitted phase diff (only the two sibling-phase red-tests failures 4j/4u skipped by name)
